_note: Shared job scheduler (tools/jobsched.py). Lower priority number runs first. agingSeconds: every N seconds of waiting a job moves up one step, so low classes are delayed, never starved. yieldMargin: how much more urgent a waiting job must be before a long job steps aside at its next checkpoint. slots: how many jobs may use the resource at once (raise on a GPU with room to spare). Add a kind of work = add a class.

lease._note: Order BETWEEN programs (Voice, face app, hub tools) for the shared GPU through the hub on this PC. No hub = no waiting (fails open).
